title: India to roll out data centre policy as concerns grow over power use
key_facts: Minister of State for IT Jitin Prasada said on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026 that India is preparing a dedicated data centre policy.
The aim is to address electricity consumption and protect consumers from higher power bills.
Local protests are underway against planned Amazon and Google projects over water, electricity and environmental concerns.
quote_evidence: India is preparing a dedicated data centre policy to address concerns over electricity consumption and protect consumers from higher power bills, Minister of State for IT Jitin Prasada said on Wednesday.
why_it_matters_hint: A national policy response to power and water worries.
